methodology.checksum: SHA-256 over ordered UTF-8 default projection fields separated by 0x1f; rows terminated by 0x1e
methodology.generation: Deterministic incremental writes; at most one source unit and its targets are resident
methodology.memory_contracts: sync/async projections are bounded streams; streaming split is bounded via temporary .lokit spools; parse.to_dict and Base split are intentionally materialized and excluded from the bounded-growth gate
methodology.python_allocations: tracemalloc peak from a dedicated, untimed, checksum-validated execution
methodology.rss: Absolute and baseline-delta resource.ru_maxrss from one checksum-validated workload per subprocess
methodology.timing: Warm-ups excluded; each sample includes projection/split construction, full consumption, and checksum
